tex_content.label: exer:maximal-smooth-atlas
tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. chA:A.9Let $M$ be a topological manifold with or without boundary. Show that every smooth atlas for $M$ is contained in a unique maximal smooth atlas, and two smooth atlases determine the same smooth structure if and only if their union is a smooth atlas. \end{exercise}
